projects.name: gmail_mail_client
projects.title: Gmail Mail Client
projects.description: Create a new private AdaOS Application named "Gmail Mail Client" from scratch. It must be CBS-compatible. Its semantic application requires capability:mail.messages.manage version ^1.0.0 without naming Gmail, a package, a skill, or credentials. For the first beta, implement an application-local Gmail binding. The UI must provide inbox search and filters, message reading, labels, archive, trash, compose and send, connection/setup status, explicit least-privilege disclosures, and deterministic empty/loading/error/permission-denied states. Account credentials and OAuth tokens must never be stored in UI state or logs. Keep shared provider reuse and a global capability registry out of this first stage.

projects.name: inbox_triage
projects.title: Inbox Triage
projects.description:
Create a new private AdaOS Application named Inbox Triage, technical id mail_inbox_triage, from scratch.

Its semantic Application requires capability:mail.messages.manage version ^1.0.0. Keep semantic intent provider-, package-, skill-, account-, and credential-neutral. At materialization time reuse an installed compatible Capability Binding and its shared Core-owned connected Gmail credential through an explicit user attachment when available. Do not create, copy, fork, or edit any Gmail provider implementation. If no reusable connection exists, offer fresh OAuth setup.

This is not a mail client. It is a focused inbox triage tool: show unread messages older than seven days and optionally starred messages; show sender, subject, date, and snippet; allow explicit mark-read, archive, star/unstar, and trash actions. Do not implement compose, send, label administration, attachment browsing, or mailbox settings.

The Prototype must be safe and deterministic. Represent loading, empty, authorization-required, reusable-account-available, connected, offline, permission-denied, provider-error, and success states without contacting Gmail and without storing secrets or real mail. Provide responsive wide and compact layouts. Explain least privilege. Prototype data is disposable synthetic review data; Automation must replace it with the selected compatible binding after acceptance.
